Learning Unit 3: Scannex Technology and Safe Use

Learning outcome: Explain the Scannex protection framework, apply the supplied exclusion and operating protocols, recognise the safety controls, and maintain accountable QA and records.

Welcome to Learning Unit 3: Scannex Technology and Safe Use. Watch the opening clip, then complete the eight activities: dose context; exclusions and alternatives; operating discipline; safety management; dose controls; QA and records; professional discipline; and the protection framework. Each activity is followed by its matching knowledge check. Review the unit recap and glossary before the final check. Select each control, enlarge the images and play or stop narration as you choose. This course uses AI-generated narration.
